full_details: You did not leave the lodging. The company played The Shrew. You were not in it. A tapster and a waterman came as far as the stair, and Mistress Ansell would not have the manner of the news in her kitchen. Master Verbeke had heard a name in the lane and would not say it twice. By supper you had the day from three mouths, no two alike. You did not go. You had never been going. In the afternoon you wrote the date on a leaf and nothing else. At night, by one candle, you spoke of the hanging, refused a likeness with the play, remembered the messenger, found no ink in the pen, and stopped.
one_sentence: You stayed in the house, heard three accounts of the hanging that did not match, and at night refused a likeness with the play.
title: Stayed in and heard three accounts of the hanging
